before.question: How are ordinary colony and research bids committed and resolved? If I bid five ships for a minimum-two card, how much do I spend on buying it; what happens if I pass or no legal card is left?
before.expected_answer: Announce total ships, secretly divide into colony, research and retained piles; any can be empty. Both bids committed before reveal. Reveal/resolve colonies then research, highest to lowest. Buy one legal card paying all five ships; minimum is an eligibility floor, not the price. Pass keeps bid; must pass if none affordable.

required_facts.fact: Announce total ships then secretly divide colony/research/retained piles, any empty
Commit both bids before reveals
Resolve colonies before research, each descending
Buy one eligible card spending all five
Passing keeps ships and is forced if none legal

after.question: How are ordinary colony and research bids committed and resolved? If I bid five ships for a minimum-two card, how much do I spend on buying it; what happens if I pass or no legal card is left?
after.expected_answer: Announce total ships, secretly divide into colony, research and retained piles; any can be empty. Both bids committed before reveal. Reveal/resolve colonies then research, highest to lowest. Buy one legal card paying all five ships; minimum is an eligibility floor, not the price. Pass keeps bid; must pass if none affordable. Colony bids reveal simultaneously when ready; research bids reveal simultaneously after colony resolution. Equal bids: fewer cards of that type, then higher species tiebreaker.

before.question: When do Zeth steal, can two stealing converters hit the same player that turn, and is a player protected after trading with Zeth, after gifting donations to Zeth, or after receiving Envoys output only as a gift?
before.expected_answer: Steal phase after Confluence at end of each turn. Each converter targets exactly one player and two converters cannot hit same player in a turn. Trade with Zeth in previous Trade protects; donation gifts and receiving Envoys as a gift do not. A clearly stated donation trade can protect if Zeth accepts.

Gifting donations to Zeth does not protect
Envoys received as gift does not protect
Explicit donation trade may be accepted or refused by Zeth
